criteria.case: 62 inclusive days across year uses exact selected grams once per day
Selection across three groups and explicit vegetables contains only chosen quantities
Group selection cannot cross group bounds or use coerced indices
Empty explicit choices create an empty draft without zero-value foods
Confirmed catalog identity is case-sensitive and never reconciles label lookalikes
Only grams unit enters shopping; mg and household measures reject atomically
A malformed meal remains unavailable without silently dropping its requested choice
Fixed source cannot mix a fixed confirmation with group selection
Recorded amounts include persisted uncompleted snapshots and never consult displayed plan choices
Detached output mutation cannot change source selections or their origin
Recorded calendar must be ordered with unique real dates and known meals
